menu.main:
Available commands:
  2 -> change Role
  3 -> add/remove favorite heroes
  4 -> update meta stats (downloads the latest version)
  5 -> configure the capture hotkey
  6 -> toggle ranking explanations
  7 -> profiles (role + favorites + preset + tier)
  8 -> model weight preset (how to score)
  sim map=<map> enemies=<h1,h2> allies=<h1,h2> -> simulate without capture
menu.small: [2] Role  [3] Favorites  [4] Update stats  [5] Hotkey  [6] Explanations  [7] Profiles  [8] Preset  [sim] Simulate
